# Split view: `jl-split-view`

Two panes with a divider to drag between them, side by side or stacked.

- Class `JlSplitView`, a template: `import { JlSplitView } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/split-view

Two panes with a divider people drag to share the room between them: side by side (horizontal, the
default) or one above the other (vertical). position is the start pane's share in percent, and each pane keeps at
least min percent.

The divider is a focusable separator: the arrows move it by 2% (10% with Shift), Home and End send it to the ends,
a double click puts it back where the page placed it. change fires once a drag ends or a key moved it. The view
takes the height of its container, and each pane scrolls on its own.

On a phone, a list and the item opened from it read better as two pages. Narrower than stack-below pixels, the view
shows one pane at a time, the one pane names (start for the list, end for the item), with the attribute stacked:
set pane to end when an item opens, and give the item a way back. stack fires when it stacks or unstacks.

## Use

```ts
import { JlButton, JlCodeBlock, JlInput, JlSplitView } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlSplitView>
  <div slot="start" style="padding: 16px">
      <JlCodeBlock language="html" heading="sign-in.html">
        <template>
          <form class="stack">
            <JlInput placeholder="Email" />
            <JlInput type="password" placeholder="Password" />
            <JlButton variant="primary" label="Sign in" block />
          </form>
        </template>
      </JlCodeBlock>
    </div>
    <div slot="end" style="display: grid; place-items: center; height: 100%; padding: 24px; background: var(--jl-surface-2)">
      <form style="display: grid; gap: 12px; width: min(100%, 260px)">
        <JlInput placeholder="Email" />
        <JlInput type="password" placeholder="Password" />
        <JlButton variant="primary" label="Sign in" block />
      </form>
    </div>
</JlSplitView>
```

```html
<jl-split-view style="height: 260px">
  <div slot="start" style="padding: 16px">
      <jl-code-block language="html" heading="sign-in.html">
        <template>
          <form class="stack">
            <jl-input placeholder="Email"></jl-input>
            <jl-input type="password" placeholder="Password"></jl-input>
            <jl-button variant="primary" label="Sign in" block></jl-button>
          </form>
        </template>
      </jl-code-block>
    </div>
    <div slot="end" style="display: grid; place-items: center; height: 100%; padding: 24px; background: var(--jl-surface-2)">
      <form style="display: grid; gap: 12px; width: min(100%, 260px)">
        <jl-input placeholder="Email"></jl-input>
        <jl-input type="password" placeholder="Password"></jl-input>
        <jl-button variant="primary" label="Sign in" block></jl-button>
      </form>
    </div>
</jl-split-view>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `orientation` (attribute `orientation`): `'horizontal' | 'vertical'`, default `'horizontal'`. Side by side, or one above the other.
- `position` (attribute `position`): `number`, default `50`. The start pane's share of the room, in percent.
- `min` (attribute `min`): `number`, default `15`. The smallest share each pane keeps, in percent.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The divider's name for screen readers. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.
- `stackBelow` (attribute `stack-below`): `number`, default `0`. Under this width, in pixels, one pane at a time; 0 never stacks.
- `pane` (attribute `pane`): `'start' | 'end'`, default `'start'`. The pane shown while stacked.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `number`: The divider moved: the new position, in percent.
- `stack` (`onStack` in JSX), detail `boolean`: It started (true) or stopped (false) showing one pane at a time.

## Slots

- `start`: The first pane: left, or top.
- `end`: The second pane: right, or bottom.

## Methods

- `reset(): void`: Puts the divider back where the position attribute placed it (50% without one).
- `isStacked(): boolean`: Whether it shows one pane at a time now.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The grid of the two panes and the divider.
- `start` (part, `::part(start)`): The start pane.
- `end` (part, `::part(end)`): The end pane.
- `divider` (part, `::part(divider)`): The divider.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Code and preview

The code on one side, what it draws on the other.

```html
      <div style="border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg); overflow: hidden; height: 260px">

<div slot="start" style="padding: 16px">
  <jl-code-block language="html" heading="sign-in.html">
    <template>
      <form class="stack">
        <jl-input placeholder="Email"></jl-input>
        <jl-input type="password" placeholder="Password"></jl-input>
        <jl-button variant="primary" label="Sign in" block></jl-button>
      </form>
    </template>
  </jl-code-block>
</div>
<div slot="end" style="display: grid; place-items: center; height: 100%; padding: 24px; background: var(--jl-surface-2)">

    <jl-input placeholder="Email"></jl-input>

    <jl-button variant="primary" label="Sign in" block></jl-button>
  </form>
</div>

```

### Vertical

An editor over its console; each pane keeps at least a quarter.

```html
<div style="border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg); overflow: hidden; height: 320px">
  <jl-split-view orientation="vertical" position="65" min="25">
    <div slot="start" style="padding: 12px">
      <jl-code-block language="ts" heading="total.js" code="const total = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price, 0);&#10;console.log(total);"></jl-code-block>
    </div>
    <div slot="end" style="padding: 12px 16px; font-family: var(--jl-font-mono); font-size: 13px">
      <div class="muted">$ node total.js</div>
      <div>128.5</div>
    </div>
  </jl-split-view>
</div>
```

### Listening

The text follows change; double-click the divider to put it back.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <div style="border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg); overflow: hidden; height: 160px">
    <jl-split-view class="demo-split" position="30" label="Resize the file list">
      <div slot="start" style="padding: 16px" class="muted">Files</div>
      <div slot="end" style="padding: 16px" class="muted">Editor</div>
    </jl-split-view>
  </div>
  <p class="muted demo-split-out">The file list takes 30%.</p>
</div>
```

```js
const split = root.querySelector('.demo-split');
const out = root.querySelector('.demo-split-out');
split.events.register('change', (position) => {
  out.textContent = `The file list takes ${Math.round(position)}%.`;
});
```

### Stacked on a phone

stack-below="480" in a 360px frame: one pane at a time, as on a phone. Opening an item shows the end pane; its back link the start pane.

```html
<div style="height: 240px; width: 360px; max-width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg); overflow: hidden">
  <jl-split-view class="demo-stack" stack-below="480" position="40">
    <div slot="start" style="display: grid">
      <jl-list-item class="demo-open" heading="Refund request from Léa Dubois" description="Answer support emails" interactive></jl-list-item>
      <jl-list-item class="demo-open" heading="Reply to Maria Rossi" description="Answer support emails" interactive></jl-list-item>
    </div>
    <div slot="end" style="display: grid; gap: 12px; align-content: start; padding: 16px">
      <div><jl-button class="demo-back" variant="ghost" size="sm" icon="arrow-left" label="Review inbox"></jl-button></div>
      <strong>Refund request from Léa Dubois</strong>
      <span class="muted">Approve the refund and tell the customer.</span>
    </div>
  </jl-split-view>
</div>
```

```js
const split = root.querySelector('.demo-stack');
for (const item of root.querySelectorAll('.demo-open')) {
  item.addEventListener('click', () => split.pane.set('end'));
}
root.querySelector('.demo-back').events.register('press', () => split.pane.set('start'));
```
